title: Week in Orbit
summary: The space and defense sectors are buzzing with activity, from SpaceX's ambitious growth plans to the latest in satellite technology and military readiness. As companies refine their offerings, the competition for contracts and innovation continues to heat up.

themes.title: SpaceX's Financial Spotlight
themes.body: SpaceX's recent IPO filing reveals its financials, shedding light on its valuation and growth strategy. With a staggering $470 billion valuation, the company is positioning itself as a dominant force in the aerospace sector.

themes.title: Military Satellite Developments
themes.body: The Space Force is pushing for in-space refueling and satellite servicing demonstrations by 2027, indicating a shift towards more sustainable space operations. Meanwhile, Anduril and L3Harris are teaming up for a tactical satellite constellation bid, highlighting the growing importance of collaboration in defense tech.

themes.title: Investment in Space Resilience
themes.body: The FY27 budget markup has added $1.4 billion to the space resilience line, signaling a commitment to enhancing national security through space capabilities. This financial boost comes at a time when geopolitical tensions are prompting increased scrutiny of space operations.

themes.title: Emerging Players in Space
themes.body: True Anomaly's recent $190 million Series C funding round underscores the influx of capital into the space sector, as new players seek to carve out niches. Meanwhile, LatConnect 60 is accelerating its investment in an AUKUS-aligned satellite constellation, reflecting a strategic focus on regional partnerships.
